title: Kuwait Says It Downed Iranian Drones as Mideast Braces for Possible Escalation
summary_full: The wave of strikes came as President Trump threatened to intensify the American campaign against Iran. U.S. embassies in the region warned of the “potential for unforeseen escalation.”
